headline: Ofgem Approves Agreement to Secure UK Gas Import Capacity
summary: The UK energy regulator Ofgem approved an agreement allowing Interconnector Limited and National Gas Transmission plc to reinforce gas import capability through the Great Britain-Belgium interconnector.
why: Ofgem regulates the electricity and downstream natural gas markets in Great Britain. Maintaining robust import interconnectors is critical for regional energy security and price stability during high-demand periods.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Reinforced import capacity alters infrastructure capabilities for gas flows between the UK and continental Europe.
